findings.detail: At least one flagged debt position has a non-USD/EURIBOR source par amount but the extracted principal_amount_usd is blank, so par analytics lack the required USD conversion field.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The issue artifact reports FX01 rows where principal_amount_usd is blank. Raw SOI row 11:18 shows SubCalidora 2 S.a r.l. Term Loan with EURIBOR + 5.750%, par amount 2,384, cost 2,522 and fair value 2,601; footnote 11 at table 24:0 identifies the investment as Spain domiciled. That source row supports the rule premise that at least this debt par is non-USD/FX-sensitive and requires an explicit USD principal conversion before USD par analytics. The stored observed value is blank, so the flag is a real extraction/normalization gap. Residual risk: the queued aggregate may include some rows that appear USD-denominated, but the reviewed item is grounded by a concrete non-USD culprit row.
